36 features vs. quoted ADR

The real shared base-pool feature set for the quoted_adr XGBoost model (36 of 36 — this model takes no force-added extras), read directly from quoted_adr_feature_importance.csv. Bars are the model's own trained importance; correlation (Pearson r for continuous/categorical features, point-biserial r for binary flags — mathematically the same formula, just the correct name when one side is 0/1 — plus Spearman ρ) is computed fresh from rfp_training_data_complete_v3.csv, filtered to room_block > 0 (n=1,705) — the same filter the pipeline itself applies before training this model, for the same reason we found last time: without it, the 194 structurally-$0-ADR meeting-only rows distort every correlation. Scatter dots are colored by real booking outcome (blue = Booked, orange = Lost) — room_block > 0 includes RFPs that ultimately lost, so this filter alone doesn't mean "won." Click any feature to see its real scatter against quoted ADR.
